Body.Content:
We are announcing the ability to enable multiple eliminations for an investment project in Dynamics 365 Project Operations. This feature will reach public preview on September 11, 2026.

How does this affect me?
This feature removes the restriction on only a single elimination transaction being permitted per investment project. With this change, finance and project accountants can post multiple elimination transactions against a single investment project—supporting staged capitalization, cost overruns, and partial expense scenarios.

What action do I need to take?
This message is for awareness, and no action is required. If you would like more information on this feature, please visit Enable multiple eliminations for an investment project.

message.Title: Dynamics 365 Project Operations- Enable multiple eliminations for an investment project
